title: O’Reilly Automotive, Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: O'Reilly Auto Parts reported a strong start to 2026, highlighted by an 8.1% increase in comparable store sales.

# O’Reilly Automotive, Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results


by[Martha Golea](https://corporate.oreillyauto.com/author/martha/)


| Jul 30, 2026


|[Content](https://corporate.oreillyauto.com/category/content/) ,[Highlighted Story](https://corporate.oreillyauto.com/category/highlighted-story/) ,[Top News](https://corporate.oreillyauto.com/category/top-news/)


We’ve released our Q2 earnings, and it was another record setter. CEO Brad Beckham said, “I would like to thank all of Team O’Reilly for their tremendous hard work and unwavering commitment to taking care of our customers each and every day.”


To see the full financial news release, please click[here](https://corporate.oreillyauto.com/2026/07/29/oreilly-automotive-inc-reports-second-quarter-2026-results/) .
